slides.title:
Our Planning
Process
slides.hook:
What we handle, from your first
message to the last song.

slides.quote: Each key wedding person/party had their own personal assistant on the day... portable mini fans during the hot evening and soft slippers for the ladies with heels to change into.

slides.lead:
Your first proposal
carries venues, vendors
and a real price.
slides.body:
Built from a call with two of us, not from a template.
Venue options that fit your events, the vendors we
would put with them, our fee and indicative pricing.

slides.lead:
You review it with us
before anything is booked.
slides.body:
We go through the recommendations and the costs.
If something does not fit your vision, your guests
or your budget, we tell you early, not late.

slides.lead:
You sign, you pay the
planning fee and the venue,
and the date is yours.
slides.body:
Nothing is held on a promise. The agreement goes out
the moment you decide to go ahead.

slides.lead:
Your dedicated planner
takes it from there.
slides.body:
One kickoff sets the timeline, the guest list
and the stages of the plan. Who is responsible
for what, how we talk, and what comes next.

slides.lead:
We shortlist the venues
that fit your events, not
the ones that photograph best.
slides.body:
Matched to your priorities, your style and budget.
Curfew, capacity, exclusive use that day,
the buggy route, a separate kitchen prep line.

slides.lead:
We lock your key vendors
before their dates go.
slides.body:
Photography and film, hair and makeup, catering,
bar, celebrant, entertainment. Availability and
deadlines in front of you, so nothing sits open.

slides.lead:
You see options at several
price points, and what
each one includes.
slides.body:
Carefully selected, never a long list.
We explain what each one includes and what it
does not, so the decision is yours to make.

slides.lead:
You always know
what is done, what is next,
and what needs you.
slides.body:
The whole plan broken into stages, and your planner
keeps every one of them in front of you.
Nothing important lives only in somebody’s inbox.

slides.lead:
We plan the whole
celebration, not just
the wedding day.
slides.body:
The welcome event, the wedding day,
the recovery day after it, and the honeymoon.

You get a real price range in your currency,
the same day. And a venue shortlist built from
your events, not from a brochure.
